faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Haryana Sports Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Haryana Sports Department Recruitment 2026 is 29th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced by the Haryana Sports Department for the posts of Doctor/Sports Injury Management, Strength & Conditioning Expert (Lead), and Young Professional.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment is 45 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Young Professional post is Rs. 40,000 per month. Other posts have different salary ranges as per their specific roles.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Haryana Sports Department recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the Doctor/Sports Injury Management post?
faq.answer: For the Doctor/Sports Injury Management post, candidates must possess an MD or Post Graduate Diploma in Sports Medicine with at least two years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Haryana Sports Department Recruitment 2026 will be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted after the initial screening will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Haryana Sports Department. Please refer to the 'Important Links' section for the website link.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I attach with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates with the application form.
